title: Hands together
goal: Play the start of Twinkle Twinkle Little Star with both hands.

steps.title: Two hands at once
steps.text: Playing with both hands is like patting your head and rubbing your tummy. It feels odd at first. We go slowly, one hand at a time, then together.

steps.title: Two colours
steps.text: Blue notes are for your right hand and pink notes for your left. The right hand sings the tune. The left holds a long low note underneath.

steps.title: Right hand, bars 1 and 2
steps.text: First the tune alone, with your right hand.

steps.title: Left hand, bars 1 and 2
steps.text: Now the low notes alone, with your left hand.

steps.title: Both hands, bars 1 and 2
steps.text: Put them together. Take your time, the song waits for you.

steps.title: Right hand, bars 3 and 4
steps.text: The next two bars, tune first.

steps.title: Both hands, bars 3 and 4
steps.text: Now both hands on bars 3 and 4.

steps.title: Check: bars 1 to 4, both hands
steps.text: The tune keeps time now, slowly. Both hands together.
